Provide comprehensive tests: constructors via factory method, getCurrentUri, getRefSchemaNode, findAncestor, findLexicalRoot, read method indirectly via getValidators, initializeValidators, hasRequiredValidator, getRequiredValidator, hasTypeValidator, getTypeValidator, isDynamicAnchor, createExecutionContext, validate (simple validation), walk (maybe stub), etc. Need to mock dependencies: ValidationContext, JsonValidator, JsonMetaSchema, Config, etc. Use Mockito to mock behavior. Provide typical use cases, edge cases, error scenarios.

We must include imports, test class, @RunWith(MockitoJUnitRunner.class) or use MockitoAnnotations.initMocks. Use JUnit 4.

We need to create minimal JSON nodes using Jackson ObjectMapper.

We need to simulate schema with "$ref", "type", "required", "$recursiveAnchor". Provide tests for combineCurrentUriWithIds, isUriFragmentWithNoContext, uriRefersToSubschema (maybe indirectly). However those are private; can't directly test but can test behavior through constructors.

Test 1: testGetCurrentUriAndSubschemaResolution: Provide a schemaNode with "id": "http://example.com/base#", currentUri null, verify combineCurrentUriWithIds returns merged uri.

But combineCurrentUriWithIds is private; we can test by constructing JsonSchema with currentUri null and schemaNode with id "#/sub". Expect currentUri null (isUriFragmentWithNoContext). Should not throw.

Test 2: testGetRefSchemaNodeLocalFragment: Build a schema node with a property "foo": {"type":"string"} and test getRefSchemaNode("#/properties/foo") returns node.

Need ValidationContext mock that returns metaSchema with getNodeByFragmentRef; but for local fragment starting with "#/" it uses node.at(...). So we can just use simple schema.

Test 3: testGetRefSchemaNodeExternalFragment: Use metaSchema mock to return node for fragment ref. Build schemaNode empty; metaSchema.getNodeByFragmentRef returns a node. Ensure method returns that.

Test 4: testInitializeValidatorsPreloadCalled: Mock JsonValidator with preloadJsonSchema verification.

Test 5: testHasRequiredValidatorAndTypeValidator: Provide schemaNode with "required": ["a"], "type":"object". Ensure getters return appropriate validator types.

We need to stub validationContext.newValidator to return mock validators.

We also need to test validate method returns errors from validators. Provide a mock validator that returns a set with a ValidationMessage.

We need to create minimal ValidationMessage class? It's part of library; we can create a simple stub using actual class if we have dependency; but we can also mock ValidationMessage as a simple object. However ValidationMessage is a final class maybe; but we can just instantiate using ValidationMessage.builder? Not sure. Simpler: mock JsonValidator.validate to return a set containing a dummy ValidationMessage (we can create via new ValidationMessage("code","path","message")). But we need to know constructor. The class is from library; we can assume there is a static of method. Use ValidationMessage.of("type","code","message")? Not sure. Maybe use mock ValidationMessage.

Simplify: Use Mockito to create a mock ValidationMessage and return a set containing it.

Test validateAndCollect: ensure ValidationResult contains same errors.

Edge Cases: test isDynamicAnchor when $recursiveAnchor true.

Test createExecutionContext uses config's supplier.

Will need to mock ValidationContext, JsonMetaSchema, SchemaValidatorsConfig, etc.

We'll create a helper method to create JsonSchema instance:

private JsonSchema createSchema(JsonNode schemaNode, URI currentUri) { ... }

We'll mock validationContext, metaSchema, config.

Set up validationContext.getMetaSchema() returns metaSchema.

validationContext.getConfig() returns config.

validationContext.newValidator(anyString, anyString, any(JsonNode.class), any(JsonSchema.class), anyString()) returns a mock JsonValidator.

validationContext.resolveSchemaId(schemaNode) returns id if present.
